# devhop
> Zero-config mobile dev proxy for testing local web apps on physical phones with working HMR, Next.js Server Actions, and microphone/camera permissions.

- CLI: `npx devhop [target]`
- Repo: https://github.com/fullstacked-labs/devhop
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/devhop
- Docs: https://github.com/fullstacked-labs/devhop#readme

## Key Capabilities
- Solves Next.js 14–16 `allowedDevOrigins` cross-origin HMR WebSocket blocking.
- Solves Next.js Server Actions CSRF origin mismatch and rewrites `x-action-redirect`.
- Solves Vite 6 `server.allowedHosts` DNS rebinding 403 Forbidden errors.
- Grants Mobile Safari & Android Chrome full Secure Context permissions (`getUserMedia`, camera, WebCrypto, Passkeys).
- Masquerades Host, Origin, and Referer headers in-process to `localhost:<port>`.
- Tolerant input parsing: accepts raw ports (`3000`), `host:port`, URLs (`http://localhost:5173`), and container addresses (`0.0.0.0`).
- Generates compact Unicode terminal QR code for instant phone camera scanning.
- Agent-ready: provides `--json` flag for automated AI coding agent workflows.
- Zero signup, zero accounts, zero cloud config, zero system daemons.
